clips.title: Launch title
clips.alt: A title card: a wordmark rises into a masked reveal, an accent rule draws in beneath it, holds, then fades out.
clips.prompt: A 14s launch title. The wordmark rises into a masked reveal, an accent rule draws in beneath it, the card holds for 2s, then fades out and lifts. One accent, no decoration, hairline rules top and bottom.

clips.title: Kinetic type
clips.alt: Six words arrive one at a time in three lines, then exit in reverse.
clips.prompt: Kinetic type. Six words across three lines, each arriving one at a time with a masked reveal, staggered 90ms, cubic-bezier(0.05, 0.7, 0.1, 1), no bounce. The words exit in reverse order.

clips.title: Product loop
clips.alt: Three beats: four pipeline stages fill in sequence, a finished frame, then a closing title card.
clips.prompt: A 21s product loop in three beats. Beat one: four stages fill in sequence, staggered 90ms, with a progress bar each. Beat two: the finished frame, a stat panel and a rule. Beat three: a closing title card. One accent, 8px rhythm.

clips.title: Footage + title
